title: Leakage-Controlled Graph Neural Networks for Residue-Level Cryptic-Pocket Prediction in PCNA
throughline: Can a leakage-clean graph neural network highlight candidate cryptic-pocket residues in PCNA — a validated cancer target — and be evaluated honestly enough that the result survives scrutiny?
draft_notice: AUTO-GENERATED DRAFT. Every figure and statistic is computed from the project's real validation data; the held-out test set was not evaluated. This draft requires human review, revision, and verification before any submission.
